name: Pipeline Memo
tagline: What’s actually happening inside B2B buying decisions.
description: Company deep dives and essays for the people who own B2B pipeline: how buyers decide, where pipeline breaks, and which decisions move revenue.
intro: Most pipeline problems get diagnosed as channel problems. Pipeline Memo looks at the system underneath: how buyers decide, how the best B2B companies built their growth machines, and what that means for the next budget call you make.
signupHeadline: Turn more of your marketing into pipeline.
signupText: Company deep dives and essays on what actually moves B2B buyers, from positioning to paid, so you can make the calls that grow revenue. Free, by email.
